candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes thromboembolic events (MCA occlusion, pulmonary emboli) but these are considered manifestations or complications of an underlying inflammatory process, which was ultimately diagnosed as primary angiitis of the central nervous system. The reference diagnosis is the primary disease, not the thromboembolic events themselves.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Thromboembolic disease is a manifestation, not the underlying cause of the primary angiitis.
